Okjökull

Okjökull (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈɔkˌjœːkʏtl̥], Ok glacier) was a glacier in western Iceland on top of the shield volcano Ok.

"Global warming" redirects here. For other uses, see Climate change (disambiguation). This article is about contemporary climate change. For historical climate trends, see Climate variability and change.

    Ok is located north-east of Reykjavík. The glacier was declared dead in 2014 by glaciologist Oddur Sigurðsson by reason of its lack of the thickness.: 35, 42 By 2017 it was less than the 2015 area of 0.7 km2 (0.27 sq mi).: 35

    Examples of some effects of climate change: Wildfire intensified by heat and drought.
